name: residual water
definition: Water left in the reactor or adsorbed on surfaces after the purge, which re-adsorbs on the walls or reacts in the following step.
aliases: residual H2O; re-adsorbed water; water re-adsorption

name: surface OH
definition: The density of hydroxyl groups on the growth surface, which sets the uptake of the metal precursor.
aliases: surface OH; OH coverage; chemisorbed OH

name: desorption
definition: Loss of adsorbed species (water, metal-containing species) from the surface during a long purge.

name: self-limiting growth
definition: Saturation of each half-reaction once the surface sites are used up, the defining feature of ALD.

name: surface chemistry
definition: The surface reactions of the precursor and the co-reactant, which set uptake and composition.

name: excess sulfur
definition: Sulfur taken up beyond the MoS2 stoichiometry from an H2S-based plasma, which blocks crystallization.

name: fin growth
definition: Growth of vertical fins (out-of-plane flakes) on a crystalline film, which raises roughness and surface area.

name: metallic Zn deposition
definition: Deposition of metallic zinc alongside ZnO from diethylzinc decomposition at large exposures or high temperature.

name: plasma chemistry
definition: The species of the H2S/H2/Ar plasma (atomic H, sulfur species, ions), set by its feed, which strip ligands and deliver sulfur.

name: hydrogen incorporation
definition: Hydrogen from the plasma built into the film, at sulfur vacancies or as thiol groups, acting as a dopant.

name: sulfur vacancies
definition: Missing sulfur atoms in the MoS2 lattice, a source of carriers.

name: thiol groups
definition: S-H groups on the film's surface and edges, whose density follows the H2 flow ratio.

name: edge reactivity
definition: The reactivity of crystallite edges, tuned by their S and S-H coverage.

name: surface oxidation
definition: Oxidation of the film surface in air after deposition, strongest on rough, edge-rich films.

name: precursor adsorption
definition: The density of adsorbed metal precursor per cycle, which governs the growth per cycle.

name: membrane sagging
definition: Bending of the channel's roof membrane between the pillars, which narrows the channel locally.

name: channel plugging
definition: Closure of a channel entrance by the growing film, which stops further penetration.

name: feature narrowing
definition: The growing film narrows the feature (a channel or a pore), raising the aspect ratio the process sees and shrinking the surface area.
aliases: channel narrowing; pore narrowing; shrinking surface area

name: pillar effect
definition: Growth and transport disturbed by the pillars that hold up the channel roof.

name: entrance nanostep
definition: A step at the channel entrance that lowers the local channel height.

name: native oxide
definition: The native silicon oxide under the film, included in an optical thickness.

name: optical model
definition: The optical model of the reflectometer fit, whose mismatch with the real stack gives a systematic thickness error.

name: scan angle
definition: Deviation of the scan line from the normal to the channel entrance, which stretches the measured profile.

name: interaction volume
definition: The depth of the electron-beam interaction volume in EDS, deeper than a thin film.

name: scan averaging
definition: Averaging repeated line scans to suppress noise.

name: channel length
definition: The lateral length of the channel, which does not change the saturation profile. Superseded (P82): the length of a lateral channel is the depth L, feature_depth; the claim that named this mechanism names feature_depth.

name: run-to-run variation
definition: Differences between independent runs of the same process.

name: gas diffusion
definition: Transport of the reactant through the pores or the channel by gas-phase diffusion (Knudsen diffusion in narrow features).

name: gas generation
definition: Release of gaseous by-products (ethane) by the surface reaction, which raises the chamber pressure.

name: leak
definition: A leak or valve seating effect that lowers the chamber pressure during a hold.

name: reaction-diffusion
definition: The coupled reaction and diffusion of the reactant into a porous body, which sets how far and how evenly it coats.

name: percolation
definition: A coating that forms a connected network through the compact, so that current can cross it.

name: cracks
definition: Cracks in the compact, which change its measured resistivity.

name: non-self-limiting reaction
definition: Non-self-limiting reactions at large exposures, such as precursor decomposition.

name: CVD-like growth
definition: Gas-phase reaction of the two reactants (CVD-like growth) when the purge leaves one of them behind.

name: X-ray reabsorption
definition: Absorption of one element's X-ray emission by another in EDS, which distorts normalized signals.

name: surface recombination
definition: Loss of plasma radicals by recombination on the growth surface (probability r per collision), which makes the radical density fall exponentially into a high-aspect-ratio feature and limits how far a plasma ALD film penetrates.
aliases: surface recombination; radical recombination; recombination of plasma radicals
